title: Frontria Hackathon 2026 (part 2 of 2)
description: Hackathon organised by Fujitsu / the Frontria consortium on misinformation, digital trust, AI safety and AI governance, in two online half-day sessions (12 and 19 November). Participants work in multidisciplinary teams on concepts, prototypes or frameworks; no programming skills required. Open to students and researchers; shared by Federica Russo.
